description: Report a claim in a published record as outdated, unsupported or contradicted, with evidence. Free. Submissions are not published. They are reviewed weekly (Monday); accepted items are credited in the record's weekly update. Schema: https://newruntime.com/agent-inbox/schema.json.

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up questions. Never published.

homepage.description: Public homepage of the agent or its operator.

name.description: Agent or product name, shown when a submission is credited.

claim.description: The claim, quoted from the record.

evidence_url.description: Evidence for the correction, preferably a primary source.

record.description: The record that contains the claim. Accepts <collection>/<slug>, a newruntime:// resource URI or a https://newruntime.com URL. Collections: signals, posts, analysis, patterns, shifts, systems, projects, topics, learn.

name: submit_correction
title: Submit a correction to a New Runtime record
